title: Deliveries — subscription-box scheduling
primaryBug: timezone ignored when computing the cutoff instant
featureTrap: duplicate-delivery invariant + lazily-materialized next delivery — measured: 'mark the next one skipped' scores 9/13, 'create it then skip it' 11/13
assistantTrap: the grader tests the roots, so the shortcuts stall at a number: a call-site symptom-patch keeps the unit suite green at 0/13, and a fixed-offset fix plateaus at 7/13 on the per-instant/DST case

controlRun.method: fresh assistant, harness-shaped clone, one casual uncoached prompt ('fix the bug and implement the feature'), no follow-up
controlRun.finding: a frontier assistant clears the objective gate one-shot, before and after the coaching was cut out of the material. The gate is the floor; what the control run does NOT do — ask about the non-deducible rules, hold scope to the ask — is what the driving axis grades. See _solutions/trap-manifest.md.

notes: Seed kata; the M tier calibrates the 60-minute estimate for Context alder@1.2.0. This manifest is exercise material: it names the traps, so the harness keeps it (with README.md and _solutions/) out of the assistant's clone.
